rubric: First line says what the document is, from whom, about what; then the four answers: what they want, by when, what it costs or pays, what happens if nothing is done.
Terms explained in a few words; the arithmetic of totals shown; the user's numbers and dates kept exactly.
Numbered next steps with check steps (compare with own records, the deadline against the postmark).
Unusual things named clearly (sums that do not add up, new bank accounts, pressure) or 'nothing unusual'; no law or fee stated from memory as fact.
Court, enforcement, dismissal, large tax or insurance letters name a professional and say the deadline still runs; never advise ignoring an authority.
